simple.meaning: כֶּסֶת (keçeth) is a Hebrew word meaning “a cushion or pillow (as covering a seat or bed).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: כֶּסֶת (H3704) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezekiel 13:18, with occurrences in Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כֶּסֶת (H3704) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in כֶּסֶת (H3704) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: כֶּסֶת (keçeth) / H3704 is traced through Ezekiel 13:18, Ezekiel 13:20 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H3704. keseth [ כֶּ֫סֶת ] noun feminine band, fillet (= charm or amulet according to Ehpraimitic source Syriac, φυλακτήρια according to ὁ Ἑβραῖος of Hexapl., compare RS JPh xiii, 286 ; in Late Hebrew כסת usually = cushion, bolster, pillow ), only plural עַלֿ כְּסָתוֺת מְתַמְּרוֺת Ezek 13:18 women sewing bands upon elbows; with suffix 2 feminine plural כִּסְתוֺתֵיכֶ֫נָה 13:20 . כֶּסֶה see כֶּסֶא . כִּסֵּה see כִּסֵּא .
